testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.wiring.persistence.JdbcIdempotencyStoreTests

testcase.name: a key that is not the derived shape is refused before the database is touched()
only the derived key, a fingerprint and counts are stored()
keys are scoped by tenant, data source and mutation()
only an expired row is purged, and a purge is bounded()
retention is configurable, a longer request wins, and anything under 7 days is refused()
a holder that vanished is not retried - after the lease the key is unknown()
markUnknown does not touch a completed key()
a key lives for the configured retention even when the caller asks for 24 hours, then it can run again()
the first call runs, a second one with the same key is in progress, other parameters conflict()
a completed mutation is replayed with its counts and result, and a conflict still applies()
concurrent callers with one key - exactly one runs()
an oversized result is dropped but the completion and count are kept()
an ambiguous outcome keeps the key reserved and is never handed out again()
a replay survives a new store instance (a restart)()
